name: Andar Bahar
description: Andar Bahar is a traditional Indian banking game of pure chance from Bangalore, Karnataka. One card is dealt face up (house card); players bet on Andar (inside) or Bahar (outside). The dealer deals alternately to each pile until a card matching the house card's rank appears; that pile wins. Also known as Mangatha or Ullae Veliyae in Tamil.

content.text: Andar Bahar is a traditional Indian banking game of pure chance from Bangalore, Karnataka. One card is dealt face up (house card); players bet on Andar (inside) or Bahar (outside). The dealer deals alternately to each pile until a card matching the house card's rank appears; that pile wins. Also known as Mangatha or Ullae Veliyae in Tamil.
Originated in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka. Also known in Tamil as Mangatha or Ullae Veliyae.
Dealer banks; any number of players bet
One card dealt face up (house card). If house card is black, first card goes to Andar; if red, to Bahar. Then cards dealt alternately to Andar and Bahar until match.
